title: Xdrip+ cant connect with Limitter. Android 9.0
symptom: After updating to Android 9.0 on LG G6, xDrip+ cannot connect to LimiTTer collector, stuck at receiving data. Other users report similar issues with MiaoMiao.
fix: Performing a factory reset of the phone resolved the issue for one user, though it chose Tomato instead of LimiTTer. A maintainer suggested trying 'Use Scanning' and 'Trust Auto-Connect' advanced bluetooth settings and ensuring latest nightly version.
evidence_quote: I've just performed a factory reset and it looks like it did the trick, though it chose Tomato as the, instead of LimiTTer. This is on the latest nightly version.
